column1: # REFERENCE GENOME REGISTRY — referenced by samples.tsv 'align_reference'.
# ref_key         Short name used in samples.tsv (e.g. GRCh38_1kGP, GRCh38_hprc).
# fasta_url       URL / s3:// / local path of the reference FASTA (bgzipped ok).
#                 Needed to decode CRAM. Downloaded once and cached locally.
# fai_url         URL of the .fai ('.' -> assume <fasta_url>.fai, else built locally).
# contig_style    'chr'  = contigs named chr1..chrX  (most GRCh38 analysis sets)
#                 'refseq'= NC_000001.11 style (needs chrom_alias for the BED)
# build           GRCh38 | CHM13   (pipeline currently assumes GRCh38)
